justification: Both depict a human figure whose head is shown with a large emphasised eye and whose arm is carved against the body, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a single isolated figure conceived in the round, upright and massively simplified with no surrounding elements, while B is a flat low-relief scene of a figure lying horizontally amid other forms and bounded by a dotted/beaded horizontal band, with fine linear detailing of a crest and fingers.
